name: IpsDocument
title: Get a stored IPS document, prepared for sharing
description:
Returns a document stored in a FHIRsmith IPS project as the web page's source view gives it for download or sharing: optionally with the narrative regenerated, signed by the user and/or the system, and with the patient's comments added - in that order. Any existing patient notes section (LOINC 51855-5) is removed before signing, and the patient's comments are added after signing, as the Composition's first section (LOINC 51855-5), so they are not signed.

What comes back is chosen by the format-type parameter, when it is given; otherwise by the Accept header (or _format, which takes the same mime types):

* json - application/fhir+json or application/json (the default): the document
* zip - application/zip: a ZIP holding the document as {name}.json
* pdf - application/pdf: a PDF of the document's narrative, with the document attached as {name}.json
* vhl - image/png: the document shared as a Verifiable Health Link (GDHCN); the response is the QR code as a PNG, with what it carries in the X-Health-Link header, the manifest URL in X-Health-Link-Manifest, and the expiry in X-Health-Link-Expires
* shl - image/png, with format-type=shl: the same, as a SMART Health Link

Accept: image/png without format-type gives a VHL. Anything else is 406. Errors are OperationOutcomes. $document shares the rate limit of the web page's sharing and signed downloads.

parameter.name: source
parameter.documentation: original (the default): the document as submitted; modified: the copy the processing pipeline made (translations, generated narrative, terminology checks). 409 if the document has not been processed yet

parameter.name: format-type
parameter.documentation: What to return: json (the document), pdf, zip, or a QR code (image/png) - shl (a SMART Health Link) or vhl (a Verifiable Health Link, the default for a QR code). When given, it decides, whatever the Accept header (or _format) says

parameter.name: user-sign
parameter.documentation: Sign as the user: the owner of the API token in the Authorization header (Bearer). 401 if there is no API token, 409 if the user has no key pair the server can sign with (made on their keys page)

parameter.name: system-sign
parameter.documentation: Sign as the system (this server). The system signs for any one address no more often than the server's configured interval: 429 if it is too soon

parameter.name: patient-notes
parameter.documentation: Include the patient's comments, as the Composition's first section (LOINC 51855-5, title 'Patient's Comments', the patient as author, the comments as narrative with status additional), added after signing. If the document has no patient comments, nothing is added and this is not an error

parameter.name: regenerate-narrative
parameter.documentation: Regenerate the narrative of the Composition and its sections with the server's IPS presenter, as the narrative tab's Generated view shows it, before any signing

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: The document (a Bundle of type document). For the other formats, the response body is the ZIP, the PDF, or the QR code's PNG, not a Parameters resource
